visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Night outdoor setting. A young woman wearing a white beanie and a white cardigan speaks excitedly to the camera in a selfie-style shot. Behind her is a brightly lit, sparkling red vintage scooter with unique square lights and a retro design. (2) The camera pans to show the scooter's footboard area where a brake pedal is located. A man in a beige sweater is seen looking at the vehicle. The lighting is dim with artificial street lamps illuminating the scene. (3) Transition to the inside of a bakery. A middle-aged man (the owner) in a black jacket and flip-flops talks to the creators. Racks of packaged bread and shop decorations are visible in the bright indoor lighting. (4) Back outside, the owner demonstrates the pop-up headlight mechanism. The young man in the beige sweater sits on the scooter, gripping the handlebars. The dashboard features analog dials and a vintage layout. (5) Close-up shot of the storage compartment under the seat being opened, revealing the internal frame and fuel tank. (6) Scene shifts to a bright indoor bedroom. The woman sits on a light blue bed, holding a smartphone and showing screenshots of a family chat and old photos of scooters to the camera.
